lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (diameter 5-12 pixels) distributed across the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows, forming a faint coordinate-like grid across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge extending horizontally across the mid-upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel gradient (brighter superior, shadowed inferior).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs concentrated along the anterior margin and central surface of the first dorsal fin mask.
